explanation: Fennecs live in the Sahara and other North African deserts. Thick fur on the soles of their feet protects them from burning sand and helps them grip loose dunes.

claims.text: Fennec foxes have very large ears that help them lose heat and hear prey moving underground.
Arctic foxes, red foxes and grey foxes have much smaller ears for their size than fennec foxes.
Fennec foxes live in the Sahara and other deserts of North Africa.
Fennec foxes have furry soles that protect their feet from hot sand and help them move on loose sand.
